fields.name: SnapNum
fields.description: Snapshot number (index in simulation output)

fields.name: Type
fields.description: Halo type (0=central, 1=satellite, 2=orphan)

fields.name: UniqueGalaxyID
fields.description: Persistent run-scoped unique galaxy ID, creation_halonr + multiplier * (forestnr_global + 1) for tree rows (multiplier = simulation.unique_galaxy_id_multiplier, default 10^9) and strictly negative -(1 + ordinal + 1024 * host_key) for created records

fields.name: UniqueCentralGalaxyID
fields.description: Persistent UniqueGalaxyID of FOF host Type 0 central galaxy (equals UniqueGalaxyID if Type=0)

fields.name: dT
fields.description: Time elapsed since progenitor snapshot (lookback time difference)

fields.name: Len
fields.description: Number of particles in halo

fields.name: Mvir
fields.description: Virial mass (M200c definition)

fields.name: deltaMvir
fields.description: Change in virial mass since last snapshot

fields.name: CentralMvir
fields.description: Virial mass of the FoF central halo stamped onto every workspace member

fields.name: Rvir
fields.description: Virial radius (radius at which density is 200 * critical density)

fields.name: Vvir
fields.description: Virial velocity (circular velocity at virial radius)

fields.name: infallMvir
fields.description: Virial mass at infall (satellites only, 0 for centrals)

fields.name: infallVvir
fields.description: Virial velocity at infall (satellites only, 0 for centrals)

fields.name: infallVmax
fields.description: Maximum circular velocity at infall (satellites only, 0 for centrals)

fields.name: Pos
fields.description: 3D position vector (comoving coordinates)

fields.name: Vel
fields.description: 3D velocity vector (peculiar velocity)

fields.name: VelDisp
fields.description: Velocity dispersion

fields.name: Vmax
fields.description: Maximum circular velocity

fields.name: Spin
fields.description: Specific angular momentum (J/Mvir)

fields.name: MostBoundID
fields.description: ID of most bound particle (original simulation halo ID)

fields.name: HaloBaryonFraction
fields.description: Local baryon fraction for this halo

fields.name: ColdGas
fields.description: Cold gas mass available for star formation

fields.name: HotGas
fields.description: Hot gas mass in halo atmosphere

fields.name: EjectedGas
fields.description: Mass of gas ejected from galaxy by feedback

fields.name: StellarMass
fields.description: Total stellar mass

fields.name: BulgeMass
fields.description: Stellar mass in bulge component

fields.name: ICS
fields.description: Intracluster stellar mass

fields.name: StarFormationRate
fields.description: Average star formation rate over snapshot (total stars formed / dT)

fields.name: MetalsStellarMass
fields.description: Metal mass in stellar component

fields.name: MetalsBulgeMass
fields.description: Metal mass in bulge component

fields.name: MetalsColdGas
fields.description: Metal mass in cold gas reservoir

fields.name: MetalsHotGas
fields.description: Metal mass in hot gas reservoir

fields.name: MetalsICS
fields.description: Metal mass in intracluster stars

fields.name: MetalsEjectedGas
fields.description: Metal mass in ejected gas reservoir

fields.name: BlackHoleMass
fields.description: Central supermassive black hole mass

fields.name: QuasarModeBHaccretionMass
fields.description: Current timestep black hole accretion mass in quasar mode

fields.name: Cooling
fields.description: Cumulative cooling energy (0.5 * m * V_vir^2), converted to erg/s and log10-transformed

fields.name: Heating
fields.description: Cumulative AGN heating energy (0.5 * m * V_vir^2), converted to erg/s and log10-transformed

fields.name: Rheat
fields.description: Heating radius from past AGN feedback events

fields.name: SupernovaOutflowRate
fields.description: Supernova-reheated gas outflow rate, SAGE26's OutflowRate

fields.name: DiskScaleRadius
fields.description: Disk scale radius (exponential disk scale length)

fields.name: TimeOfLastMajorMerger
fields.description: Lookback time of the galaxy's last major merger (mass ratio strictly above ThresholdMajorMerger), as SAGE26 writes it; -1 times the unit factor if it never had one

fields.name: TimeOfLastMinorMerger
fields.description: Lookback time of the galaxy's last minor merger (every merger not above ThresholdMajorMerger), as SAGE26 writes it; -1 times the unit factor if it never had one

fields.name: Regime
fields.description: Gas accretion regime of the halo - 0 = CGM regime, 1 = hot-halo regime, -1 = not yet assigned

fields.name: FFBRegime
fields.description: Feedback-free-burst regime of the halo - 0 = normal halo, 1 = FFB halo

fields.name: CGMgas
fields.description: Gas mass in the circumgalactic medium (CGM), the hot-phase reservoir of CGM-regime halos

fields.name: MetalsCGMgas
fields.description: Metal mass in the circumgalactic medium (CGM) gas

fields.name: tcool
fields.description: Cooling-time diagnostic - the hot recipe's float(Rvir/Vvir) * 1e10/Hubble_h * SEC_PER_GIGAYEAR/UnitTime_in_s (not Gyr), or with CGMrecipeOn 1 the CGM recipe's time in h^2 Gyr or 0 after the CGM reset; -1 until first set

fields.name: tff
fields.description: Free-fall diagnostic - the hot recipe's sqrt(2) float(Rvir/Vvir) * 1e10/Hubble_h * SEC_PER_GIGAYEAR/UnitTime_in_s (not Gyr), or with CGMrecipeOn 1 the CGM recipe's in Gyr/h, or -1 (reset, restored hot); -1 until first set

fields.name: RcoolToRvir
fields.description: Cooling radius over the float virial radius at the last hot cooling call that formed one (uncapped, can exceed 1); early returns and CGM cooling leave it; -1 if never evaluated or after the CGMrecipeOn 1 reset

fields.name: CoolingRate
fields.description: Cooled mass over the substep times 1e10/Hubble_h * SEC_PER_GIGAYEAR/UnitTime_in_s (Msun/Gyr over h) - CGMrecipeOn 0 the suppressed hot mass at SAGE26's tail, CGMrecipeOn 1 the applied CGM plus hot mass

fields.name: mdot_cool
fields.description: Hot-halo cooling rate of the hot regime's cold-stream recipe before the reservoir cap and AGN suppression, in Msun/yr (0 with CGMrecipeOn 0)

fields.name: mdot_stream
fields.description: Cold-stream cooling rate of the hot regime's cold-stream recipe before the reservoir cap and AGN suppression, in Msun/yr (0 with CGMrecipeOn 0)

fields.name: H2gas
fields.description: Mass of molecular hydrogen (H2) in the cold gas reservoir

fields.name: H1gas
fields.description: Mass of atomic hydrogen (HI) in the cold gas reservoir

fields.name: H2DepletionTime_Gyr
fields.description: Molecular-gas depletion time from the K13 prescription, -1 if not applicable

fields.name: SfrDisk
fields.description: Disk star formation rate averaged over the snapshot substeps, in Msun/yr

fields.name: SfrBulge
fields.description: Bulge (starburst) star formation rate averaged over the snapshot substeps, in Msun/yr

fields.name: SfrDiskZ
fields.description: Mean metallicity (metal mass / cold gas mass) of the cold gas forming disk stars, averaged over the snapshot substeps

fields.name: SfrBulgeZ
fields.description: Mean metallicity (metal mass / cold gas mass) of the cold gas forming bulge stars, averaged over the snapshot substeps

fields.name: MassLoading
fields.description: Supernova mass-loading factor eta, the ratio of reheated gas mass to stars formed in the current star formation episode

fields.name: BulgeRadius
fields.description: Effective (half-mass) radius of the bulge, 0 for a galaxy with no bulge mass

fields.name: MergerBulgeRadius
fields.description: Half-mass radius of the merger-built (classical) bulge, 0 for a galaxy with no bulge mass

fields.name: InstabilityBulgeRadius
fields.description: Half-mass radius of the disk-instability-built (pseudo) bulge, 0 for a galaxy with no bulge mass

fields.name: MergerBulgeMass
fields.description: Stellar mass of the bulge built through mergers

fields.name: InstabilityBulgeMass
fields.description: Stellar mass of the bulge built through disk instabilities (the instability channel of BulgeMass)

fields.name: ICS_disrupt
fields.description: In-situ ICS, the cumulative satellite stellar mass stripped directly into this halo's ICS reservoir

fields.name: ICS_accrete
fields.description: Ex-situ ICS, the cumulative already-formed ICS brought into this halo by infalling or merging satellites

fields.name: ICS_sum_mt
fields.description: Mass-weighted sum of m*t at ICS deposition, in 1e10 Msun/h times code time; divide by ICS_disrupt + ICS_accrete for the mean assembly lookback

fields.name: infallStellarMass
fields.description: Stellar mass of the galaxy when it became a satellite; SAGE26 writes 0 for centrals (Type 0)

fields.name: TimeOfInfall
fields.description: Snapshot number at which the galaxy last became a satellite (not a time); -1 = never; SAGE26 writes 0 for centrals (Type 0)

fields.name: Concentration
fields.description: NFW halo concentration, set at joining for a new FoF central that was a Type 0 or 1, by SAGE26's Vmax/Vvir inversion (ConcentrationOn 3, R5; a former satellite's infall pair), 0 if (Vmax/Vvir)^2 < 1; 0 throughout with ConcentrationOn 0 (R0-R4)
